meta.workDescription: This JSTO is all-encompassing for operations and mission support, to include the Command, Integration, C2, Strike, and ISET UTCs.
meta.hazardAnalysis: Reference JHAs and AFSPECWAR Occupational Hazards memo in the Safety Program binder.
meta.riskManagementNotes: RM fundamentals are refreshed multiple times throughout the year and ORM is conducted prior to every major training event.
meta.motorcycleSafetyReps: Unit MSRs are CPT Chris Campbell (Pri) and SSG Timothy Auker (Alt).
meta.emergencyNumbers: Call 911 for emergencies and for base defense concerns call the Camp Murray JDOC at 253-512-2168.
meta.medicalFacility: Personnel will perform SABC and call 911 as required for injuries. The nearest medical facility is Madigan Army Medical Center and their emergency room is open 24/7. The hospital is located across I-5 from Camp Murray.
meta.evacuation: Muster point for emergencies is the gravel parking lot on the south side of Building 116.
meta.bulletinBoard: The safety bulletin board is located on the wall between the male and female bathrooms near the gym.

selectedModules.title: Hazard Communication
selectedModules.reference: AFI 90-821 - Hazard Communication (HAZCOM) Program; 29 CFR 1910.1200 - Hazard Communication
selectedModules.trainingRequirement: Provide effective training at initial assignment and whenever a new chemical hazard is introduced. Cover where hazardous chemicals are present, the written program, labels and SDS access, how releases are detected, hazard types, protective measures, emergency procedures, and required PPE.
selectedModules.trainingSource: OSHA 2254 - Training Requirements in OSHA Standards / 29 CFR 1910.1200 - Hazard Communication
selectedModules.afTrainingRequirement: Employees potentially exposed to chemical hazards must complete HAZCOM training upon initial assignment and whenever a new hazard or chemical is introduced or new tasks create new hazards. Supervisors must ensure SDS access for chemicals used in the work process.
selectedModules.afTrainingSource: DAFMAN 91-203 - Air Force Occupational Safety, Fire and Health Standards para. 28.2.5 and para. 28.3.3
